2026-02-01.title: The Author of It All
2026-02-01.verse: Not that we are adequate in ourselves to consider anything as if it were coming from ourselves, but our adequacy is from God, who made us adequate to be servants of a new covenant not based on the letter but on the Spirit, for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
2026-02-01.observation: God truly is in control of all things. There really isn’t a more hopeful thought. No matter what happens and even if you believe that God has given us full rights to choose our own journey, God is still ultimately in control. He can make all things work out for His purposes in our lives. Then, when we realize how much He loves us, all is well.
2026-02-01.application: Trust the Lord to give you what you need, when you need it, to perform His will.
2026-02-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for showing us a good, good Father.

2026-02-02.title: Keep the Main Thing the Main Thing
2026-02-02.verse: For we do not proclaim ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your slaves for Jesus’ sake.
2026-02-02.observation: As a pastor and preacher, this speaks to me to remember who I am always trying to bring attention to. It is never me or what I am doing. It is always Jesus and what He is doing in the lives of His people. This concept is good for us all. If we talk about ourselves and bring attention to ourselves, we will quickly run out of things to say. If we are constantly bringing attention to Jesus, we will always have a great subject.
2026-02-02.application: Keep Jesus the focus of your life.
2026-02-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being worthy.

2026-02-03.title: Believing Is Seeing
2026-02-03.verse: for we live by faith, not by sight.
2026-02-03.observation: It is a shame this phrase has been co-opted by stories concerning Santa Claus. It takes away from the power of what Paul is saying. There are so many things in life that we believe that have nothing to do with what we see. For example, the wind. We cannot see the wind, but we believe it exists because we feel it and see its effects on others. God is like that. He exists outside of space and time, yet fills all of space and time as well. There is nowhere we can go that He is not already there. So, we believe in God, not because we see Him visibly, but because we see His effects everywhere.
2026-02-03.application: See God by believing that He is. Then you will see Him everywhere.
2026-02-03.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for showing Yourself to us in a thousand ways.

2026-02-04.title: Let It Be Enough
2026-02-04.verse: Now because we are fellow workers, we also urge you not to receive the grace of God in vain.
2026-02-04.observation: There’s an old phrase that says, “If one is good, two is better.” Hedonism is the idea of complete self-indulgence. Always wanting more. This is dangerous. I have heard of people who have everything who take their own life because they feel they still want more but there is nothing left to strive for. The idea of constantly wanting more will destroy the beauty of what you already have. The greatest miracle you could ever hope for has already been given to you. The marvelous gift of salvation. That is enough. Live in the joy of knowing your sins have been forgiven.
2026-02-04.application: Thank God every day for salvation.
2026-02-04.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for saving us.

2026-02-05.title: Ultimate Source of Encouragement
2026-02-05.verse: But God, who encourages the downhearted, encouraged us by the arrival of Titus.
2026-02-05.observation: God is not interested in you experiencing all the “bad things” for no reason. His ultimate plan for you is good. That doesn’t mean we will never experience hardships, suffering, or pain. Sorrow is part of life. Many people who love the Lord experience so many bad things. God uses every one for His good work in our lives. However, never forget the ultimate goal of the Lord is our good and our encouragement.
2026-02-05.application: God’s will for your life is to be encouraged in all situations. This does not mean He will remove the cause of the suffering. It DOES mean He will be with you while you endure it.
2026-02-05.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us through all things.

2026-02-06.title: Never Forget What Jesus Did
2026-02-06.verse: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that although he was rich, he became poor for your sakes, so that you by his poverty could become rich.
2026-02-06.observation: Jesus’ existence did not begin with the manger. John 1 says Jesus as the incarnate Word existed before time. He entered into space and time and became one of us. He “took off” His glory while never losing any of His glory and walked with us. The Holy Spirit is still with us. Never forget what Jesus was willing to do to reach us.
2026-02-06.application: Be thankful today for such a great Savior.
2026-02-06.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us.

2026-02-07.title: Give God Something to Work With
2026-02-07.verse: My point is this: The person who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and the person who sows generously will also reap generously. Each one of you should give just as he has decided in his heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, because God loves a cheerful giver.
2026-02-07.observation: We ask God to bless us but then don’t do our part to place our resources in His hand. It would be like asking a great chef to cook an amazing meal, but then giving them no ingredients. God could do it without our participation. He created everything we see with nothing. However, this is not His plan or His way. He created us to be in fellowship and partnership with Him. Therefore, He always waits to do life with us.
2026-02-07.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, because You model generosity by how You treat us.

2026-02-08.title: We Fight From Victory, Not For It
2026-02-08.verse: for the weapons of our warfare are not human weapons, but are made powerful by God for tearing down strongholds. We tear down arguments and every arrogant obstacle that is raised up against the knowledge of God, and we take every thought captive to make it obey Christ.
2026-02-08.observation: The language Paul uses is not one of hope without reason. He declares that we are taking ground. Jesus won the victory over all of this when He rose from the dead. Our job is to advance His kingdom into all the world. Ultimate victory is already assured.
2026-02-08.application: Move forward with confidence. The King is undefeated.
2026-02-08.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for winning it all.

2026-02-09.title: People Connect Over Shared Struggles
2026-02-09.verse: If I must boast, I will boast about the things that show my weakness.
2026-02-09.observation: No one enjoys showing their weakness. We like to be liked by others and be thought of as doing well. However, if we truly want to connect with people, we have to be willing to show our other side as well. This doesn’t mean we walk around looking pitiful or embarrassing ourselves. We walk around being self-aware and being honest when the time is right. The goal is to show people we are human and to display the goodness of God through our lives. People will respect you because of your successes, but will connect with you in shared struggles.
2026-02-09.application: Pull back the curtain, occasionally, and be honest. It may give other people permission to be human.
2026-02-09.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for truly knowing us.

2026-02-10.title: How to Experience God’s Strength
2026-02-10.verse: But he said to me, “My grace is enough for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” So then, I will boast most gladly about my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may reside in me.
2026-02-10.observation: In Philippians 3:10, Paul says he wants to “know Christ and the power of His resurrection.” This prayer is answered by the verse above. It’s unfortunate that it works this way, but the best way to experience the strength and power of God is to get to the end of your own. Only then can you fully know the difference. If you find yourself able to handle adversity, you might be tempted to think it was your good idea or your ability to cope. However, when you get to the end of your strength yet find yourself able to carry on and things work out… you realize God has been carrying you for a while now.
2026-02-10.application: Don’t seek difficult times, but don’t fear them. God is there.
2026-02-10.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for never leaving us.

2026-02-11.title: How to Guarantee God Will Be With You
2026-02-11.verse: Finally, brothers and sisters, rejoice, set things right, be encouraged, agree with one another, live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
2026-02-11.observation:
Paul has been on a long journey with this church. This is the 4th letter he has written to them. In these final statements, he summarizes the overall message. It’s like a pastor giving his final address and he wants to summarize everything he has ever told them. Let’s get the bottom line and the brass tacks. If you want to know for sure God is with you and God is pleased with you and you needed something quick that you could take with you… 

- Be joyful- Joy is a choice, not an emotion. Choose joy.
- Grow in maturity- keep growing.
- Encourage each other- be a blessing to others.
- Live in harmony- Don’t try to make everyone like you in the little things. Work in cooperation and focus on the big things.
- Live in peace- fight for peace.
2026-02-11.application: Unity and harmony take work. God rewards it with His peace. Fight for peace.
2026-02-11.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us in this long journey.

2026-02-12.title: The Lord Is Here
2026-02-12.verse: Then Haggai, the Lord’s messenger, spoke the Lord’s announcement to the people: “I am with you,” decrees the Lord.
2026-02-12.observation: One of the greatest encouragements the Lord consistently gives to His people is the promise of His presence. This is a big deal. As a father, I wanted to attend every sporting event my girls participated in. Honestly, the main reason was not so I could affect the game. The reason was because I knew it affected them. When I was there, I could see them constantly looking over to make sure I could see and that my eyes were on them. My presence gave them confidence and made them want to try just a little harder. This is what God is saying. He’s telling the people that He is “in the stands” and watching over them. They can move forward knowing He is cheering them on and ready to act on their behalf. How would it change your day to know that your Heavenly Father is in the stands watching you with a smile on His face. Not because He expects you to do something great today, but simply because you are His.
2026-02-12.application: Live today as though the King is smiling at you.
2026-02-12.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being with us in every situation and through every circumstance.

2026-02-13.title: God Promises
2026-02-13.verse: The seed is still in the storehouse, isn’t it? And the vine, fig tree, pomegranate, and olive tree have not produced. Nevertheless, from today on I will bless you.’
2026-02-13.observation: I still remember one of my girls crying with a bag of garbage in her hand. Her household chore was to take out the trash. She had waited until after dark, and was now afraid to go outside. Having been just out there, I knew everything was okay and the trash can was just a few steps away from the back door. That doesn’t matter to a young, creative mind. She had pictured many different enemies waiting just outside the door. Finally, I told her I had already been out there and I promise it is okay. “But, I’m scared, daddy.” The only thing I could do is to say, “I know. That’s okay, but you’re going anyway. It has to be done. I’ll go with you.” Just in case you’re wondering, we made it. This verse reminds me of the same. The people were likely concerned about possible enemy nations surrounding them, possible enemies next door, and wondering if they could do all that was required. God is promising that it will be okay and that He is going with them. There is no greater promise than that.
2026-02-13.application: Walk through life today as though God is with you, because He is.
2026-02-13.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us through every difficulty.

2026-02-14.title: Play for the Coach, Not the Crowd
2026-02-14.verse: Am I now trying to gain the approval of people, or of God? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a slave of Christ!
2026-02-14.observation: In sports, it can be easy to get confused. The crowd will cheer you on when you do well and make a big play. However, they can easily grow restless when the game slows down and nothing seems to be happening. They like action and excitement. If you play for the crowd, you will always run into difficulty. The coach knows you and knows the game. He knows that games are not won and lost on the ‘big plays’ but the little things the crowd doesn’t notice. If you play for the crowd, you’ll soon lose perspective. If you focus on the coach, you will experience more joy in the journey and keep your life in balance.
2026-02-14.application: Focus on pleasing God, not just people.
2026-02-14.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being EASY to please. You want good things for us, and all Your laws are meant to keep us safe.

2026-02-16.title: A Supernatural Change
2026-02-16.verse: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. So the life I now live in the body, I live because of the faithfulness of the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.
2026-02-16.observation: Someone asked me once what the difference is between Jesus’ command not to judge others and His call to know the “fruit on the tree” in Matthew 7. Here is the difference: We never judge someone’s motives. That’s impossible. I cannot read minds and you can’t either. However, we can clearly see the fruit of their lives. Paul is saying that something miraculous happened when he gave his life to Christ. It was as though his own nature had been crucified and died. Now, his intention is to live for Christ because Christ lives in him. How do you know if someone is saved? First of all, we can’t. Only God knows. What we can know is if they are living the life of someone who has truly been BORN AGAIN into the kingdom of God. Our affections change. We may still sin as before, but our heart is now grieved over it.
2026-02-16.application: Look within yourself. Have your affections changed? If you still have the same sin in your life, do you find that it is a struggle… there is something within you that wants to be free? That may be proof you have been born again. The Holy Spirit within you longs to set you free.
2026-02-16.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for changing our affections.

2026-02-17.title: We Live Free Because, Not For
2026-02-17.verse: The only thing I want to learn from you is this: Did you receive the Spirit by doing the works of the law or by believing what you heard? Are you so foolish? Although you began with the Spirit, are you now trying to finish by human effort?
2026-02-17.observation: For some, Paul walks a tightrope throughout Galatians. On one end, he says we are saved by nothing we can achieve. Salvation is by the grace of God. However, he also says we should live without sin. Is this contradictory? Not when you consider why we live free from sin. Before salvation, we could not live without continual sin, and why would we want to? After salvation, Jesus frees us from the prison of ways we medicate our life when it is independent of God… what we call sin. Therefore, we work hard to live free from sin BECAUSE God is for us and loves us, not for His forgiveness.
2026-02-17.application: Live free because you no longer need sin to medicate your broken places. You can run to God for true healing and wholeness.
2026-02-17.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for setting us free.

2026-02-18.title: The Long Game
2026-02-18.verse: But when the appropriate time had come, God sent out his Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
2026-02-18.observation: God has planned your salvation since before you were born. He has been working on your freedom before you even realized you needed it. This was the paradoxical problem God knew would happen when He chose to create humans. In order for us to love, we had to be given free will and choice. Love cannot be compelled. However, this also has a baked-in problem. If we can choose to love God, we can also choose to go our own way. We would need a way back. So, before the foundation of the world, God made a plan of salvation. In the fullness of time, He enacted that plan. It was a rescue mission. Jesus came to pay the price we couldn’t pay so we can find salvation through Him. Thank goodness He did.
2026-02-18.application: Realize how much God loves you and love Him back by giving Him your life.
2026-02-18.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us.

2026-02-19.title: God Grows What We Truly Need
2026-02-19.verse: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
2026-02-19.observation: If you think about it, why do we want good things? Why do we want a bigger house, a better car, a bigger salary, and all sorts of other nice things? What is behind those things? It’s the desire to be secure, the desire to have joy, to give and receive love, and to finally be content with life. All these things are the attributes that grow in us through a relationship with the Holy Spirit. All the Lord longs for, God wants to grow in us.
2026-02-19.application: Spend time with God daily and watch the fruit grow in your life.
2026-02-19.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for knowing what we truly need.

2026-02-20.title: Don’t. Give. Up.
2026-02-20.verse: So we must not grow weary in doing good, for in due time we will reap, if we do not give up.
2026-02-20.observation: During WW2, Winston Churchill was quoted as saying, “Never, never, never, never give up.” Some say he single-handedly kept the hearts and minds of the English people in the war well beyond what many thought they could endure. He encouraged them to stay strong while their towns were demolished by bombs and families were killed. They stayed strong and, with help, won the war. The same is true for us. We have no idea what is coming around the next corner. Maybe relief is just a day away. We cannot control tomorrow. We can control our effort and our willingness to not give up.
2026-02-20.application: Don’t. Give. Up… one more day.
2026-02-20.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for never giving up on us.

2026-02-21.title: The Heart of God
2026-02-21.verse: Therefore say to the people: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies says, ‘Turn to me,’ says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, ‘and I will turn to you,’ says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
2026-02-21.observation: The nation of Israel had been in exile for 70 years. This would mean that only the oldest people would remember the days before Israel had been conquered. Those days were likely bittersweet and filled with difficulty and wars. Now, the Lord was calling the people to come home. The view of this is not a moment when God has decided to no longer be mad. A better way to view this is God with His hand out saying He is waiting for them. What if we could see the Lord like this? He is not looking at us with eyes of anger, but with His hand outstretched. He is calling us back to Himself.
2026-02-21.application: Is there a place in your life where you have “left home” or walked away from the Lord? How will you return to Him and recommit yourself to Him today?
2026-02-21.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for never giving up on us and always calling us home.

2026-02-22.title: God Gives Us A Future
2026-02-22.verse: and said to him, “Hurry, speak to this young man as follows: ‘Jerusalem will no longer be enclosed by walls because of the multitude of people and animals there.
2026-02-22.observation: Many times it seems we have to hit rock bottom before we come to the Lord or return home. In the story of the prodigal son, I think most of us identify more with the son who left than the one who stayed. Then, when we return home, we are expecting the pieces to never fit back together again. We expect that nothing will ever be good again. This is not true. While it is true that things will not be the same, the Lord has a new adventure and a new hope for us. Yes, what was may never be the same again. However, the Lord is the Author of new things, new days, and new mercies for every morning.
2026-02-22.application: How can God turn your current situation into something new if you turn wholeheartedly to Him?
2026-02-22.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always having good plans for us.

2026-02-23.title: Peace is on the way
2026-02-23.verse: In that day,’ says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, ‘everyone will invite his friend to fellowship under his vine and under his fig tree.’
2026-02-23.observation: The nation of Israel is not in a current era of peace. They have an uphill battle of reclaiming their land, cleaning up from 70 years of overgrowth, and rebuilding the temple. However, the Lord promises that on the other side of the uphill journey, peace is coming. This is good for us to remember as well. The journey toward freedom takes time. It is uphill. It is not always easy. However, on the other side of the journey, there is peace. Don’t give up. Don’t quit. The arrival is worth the journey.
2026-02-23.application: Where do you need to take a deep breath, keep calm, and carry on? The Lord is in control.
2026-02-23.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always leading us in the right direction.

2026-02-24.title: God is the Engine
2026-02-24.verse: Therefore he told me, “This is the Lord’s message to Zerubbabel: ‘Not by strength and not by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
2026-02-24.observation: Imagine you are on one side of the ocean and had to get to the other. You are in a little row boat. In this scenario, you have enough food and shelter for the journey. You also have the desire to get to the other side. The problem is, how are you possibly going to row your way across the ocean? That is impossible. Literally, there’s no way to do it in your own strength. Then, imagine someone comes along and gives you a massive engine to propel the journey. That person changed the whole journey. You went from having no way to move forward to excited for the adventure. It was still going to be hard. There were going to be many things to deal with along the way. But, it was no longer impossible. This is what God is saying through the prophet Zechariah to the people. You have a long, hard journey ahead of you. However, you are not supposed to do it alone. God is declaring He will be the source of strength. The same is true for us today.
2026-02-24.application: Trust the Lord to be the source of strength you need when you lean on Him today.
2026-02-24.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being more than enough for all we need today.

2026-02-25.title: The God of Justice
2026-02-25.verse: I will send it out,” says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, “and it will enter the house of the thief and of the person who swears falsely in my name. It will land in the middle of his house and destroy both timber and stones.
2026-02-25.observation: In today’s chapter, God uses the illustration of a flying scroll to make a point. The scroll represented the fact that justice was flying out to all whom it needed to be sent. God had not missed any of the injustice that was happening. God was sending His justice to those who needed it until they were completely destroyed. This may not mean much to some, but there are those who have suffered in silence over watching injustice go seemingly unnoticed for a long time. God assures us that it is not unnoticed. At the right time, God always comes through.
2026-02-25.application: Take a sigh of relief and be content with what you see. Grieve over injustice and do what you can, but trust that the Lord will not let it go ultimately unpunished.
2026-02-25.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always seeing, knowing, and coming through.

2026-02-26.title: The Lord Proves Himself
2026-02-26.verse: Then those who are far away will come and build the temple of the Lord so that you may know that the Lord of Heaven’s Armies has sent me to you. This will all come to pass if you completely obey the voice of the Lord your God.”’
2026-02-26.observation: The Lord says that all He has said will come to pass. This is how they will be able to know that He is truly God. All they have to do is obey. This would be like someone giving you a treasure map. They say that, at the end of the journey, there will be a treasure chest full of gold. Not certain if this is true, you ask the giver of the map to prove the treasure’s existence. Their reply is that the proof is finding the treasure. If you will only follow the map, you will find the treasure just as it says and you can keep it. All it takes is a little faith to get there. This is what God is saying. If the people will obey Him, good things are coming. He says the same to us. He promises that if we will obey His Word, He will be with us through every journey of life.
2026-02-26.application: Where do you need to trust God and keep moving?
2026-02-26.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the map and walking with us every step of the way.

2026-02-27.title: Show Justice to Each Other
2026-02-27.verse: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies said, ‘Exercise true judgment and show brotherhood and compassion to each other. You must not oppress the widow, the orphan, the resident foreigner, or the poor, nor should anyone secretly plot evil against his fellow citizen.’
2026-02-27.observation: The Lord doesn’t just work out justice in our own lives, He gives us the opportunity to do good toward others. We have the opportunity to be a blessing to other people. We also have the opportunity to help those who need it. Because God is so good to us, we can open our eyes to see the opportunity to bless others around us.
2026-02-27.application: Be looking for someone to bless today.
2026-02-27.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for blessing us so that we can be a blessing to someone else.

2026-02-28.title: What Do People Hear About You?
2026-02-28.verse: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies says, ‘In those days 10 people from all languages and nations will grasp hold of—indeed, grab—the robe of one Jew and say, “Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.”’
2026-02-28.observation: In this passage, God is encouraging the people to be faithful to God and rebuild. Not at that time, but in the days to come, people will see that God was moving all the time. This is how it works with us so many times. We do not always see God moving in the moment. Our job is faithfulness. However, as we continue to be faithful and grow, people begin to notice our progress. Is this true of you? Are you being faithful, even though it doesn’t always look good on the outside? Are you creating a legacy of someone who refuses to quit? What are people going to hear when they are told about you?
2026-02-28.application: Stay faithful. God is building a legacy. People may be able to say it in a few words, but it will take a lifetime to build.
2026-02-28.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for growing with us over the long term.
